summary: This YAML configuration file sets up a simple website project with branding details. It defines the project type as a website and then specifies the website's title, navigation bar appearance, and social/external links like GitHub.

explanations.2: This declares what kind of project this is—in this case, a website (as opposed to a book, presentation, or other document type).
explanations.6: The navbar section configures the top navigation bar that appears on the website.
explanations.8: The tools array is a list of external links or social icons that appear in the navbar—each one needs an icon name and a URL.
explanations.9: The icon property specifies which icon to display (like a GitHub logo), and href on the next line is the web address it links to.
